title: FlexLine Credit Review: Lateness Addition to the Review Cut
content:
**Schedule — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit credit reviews.** The lateness cut is added to the review cut by the days past due on the review date: 25 days or more add 0.10; 15 to 24 days add 0.05; fewer days add nothing.

The review cut is the share of the credit limit a review takes off; 0.10 is 10 percentage points of the limit and 0.05 is 5. Days past due are the calendar days from the line's next due date to the review date while an amount is past due.

| Days past due on the review date | Added to the review cut |
|---|---|
| 25 or more | 0.10 |
| 15 to 24 | 0.05 |
| fewer than 15 | nothing |

*Hypothetical boundary:* with a next due date of 3 March and an amount past due, a review on 18 March is 15 days past due (adds 0.05), on 27 March 24 days (adds 0.05) and on 28 March 25 days (adds 0.10).
